title: Marginal-Contribution Policy Gradients under Filtered Feedback for Multi-Agent LLMs
mechanism: Background-conditioned contribution and propensity correction support training signals; square-root allocation trades exact-evaluation cost against gradient-weighted estimation error.
mab2_boundary: Conditional credit and budgeted correction are not standalone novelty. The stated allocation assumes independent Bernoulli evaluations and an expected-cost constraint; this is not a proof for a hard cap with shared caches or future graph-edit utility.
